title: chat
description: An exchange as bubbles, or a single prompt or quote as a bordered card. `shown` says how many messages are visible (hidden ones keep their space), and `typing` types the newest message on a forward step. Set `shown` per step with `advance` or `set` on the slide.

messages.description: The messages, in order. `role` is `user` (right in bubbles), `agent` or `note` (left). `label` is an optional line above the text, shown at the label size. `text` is inline Markdown (emphasis, code, links); raw HTML is shown as text.

label.description: Optional line above the text, for example a name or `The brief`.

style.description: `bubbles`: rounded bubbles, `user` on the right and the rest on the left. `card`: full-width bordered cards with the label at the top, for a prompt or a quote.

shown.description: How many messages are visible (messages 0..shown-1); all when absent. Hidden messages keep their space, so nothing reflows. New messages rise and fade in, staggered, on a forward step.

typing.description: Type the text of the newest message, character by character, when it appears on a forward step. Jumping or going backward shows the full text at once.
